intro: The Pro-X shares its shell and drawer with the Ultra but trades the camera for weight-based health tracking. Most Pro-X questions are about the drawer: how often it fills, and what goes in it once the bundled liners run out.

facts.text: CATLINK rates the 13 L waste bin at up to 14 days with one cat, or 7 days with two.
Odour control combines three layers with a carbon filter inside a sealed globe chamber.
Radar and infrared sensors pause cleaning the moment a cat is detected inside.
Health monitoring tracks each cat's weight and bathroom habits and sends alerts when they change.

symptoms.title: Replacement bags do not fit the drawer
symptoms.summary: Once the 60 bundled liners run out, ordinary bags are too small for the drawer.
causes: Grocery bags are not big enough for a drawer this size.

fixes.detail: Standard 8-gallon trash bags fit the Pro-X drawer, so you are not tied to CATLINK refills.

symptoms.escalate: If 8-gallon bags interfere with the drawer seating, CATLINK's own liners are the fallback.

symptoms.title: The drawer fills faster than expected
symptoms.summary: The drawer needs emptying around weekly rather than every two weeks.
causes: The 14-day figure applies to one cat. CATLINK rates two cats at about 7 days.

fixes.detail: With two cats, budget a weekly empty. With three or more, expect to go sooner.

symptoms.escalate: If one cat fills it in under a week, check the litter level — overfilling sends clean litter into the drawer with the waste.
